member.name: T:DotVVM.BusinessPack.Messaging.MessageHandler
member.summary: Defines a command which will be triggered when a specified hub method is called on the server.

member.name: P:DotVVM.BusinessPack.Messaging.MessageHandler.MethodName
member.summary: Gets or sets the name of the hub method.

member.name: P:DotVVM.BusinessPack.Messaging.MessageHandler.ConnectionId
member.summary: Gets or sets the ConnectionId of MessagingConnection to which this handler will be bound. Use this method only if the MessageHandler is not placed in the MessagingConnection element.

member.name: P:DotVVM.BusinessPack.Messaging.MessageHandler.Command
member.summary: Gets or sets the command that will be triggered when a hub method is called. To access the parameters, please define the command as a lambda method - for example: (int number) => Value = Value + number

member.name: T:DotVVM.BusinessPack.Messaging.MessagingConnection
member.summary: Maintains a SignalR connection to a hub with a specified URL.

member.name: P:DotVVM.BusinessPack.Messaging.MessagingConnection.ServiceUrl
member.summary: Gets or sets the URL of the SignalR hub.

member.name: P:DotVVM.BusinessPack.Messaging.MessagingConnection.ReconnectAttempts
member.summary: Gets or sets the maximum number of attempts to reconnect to the hub.

member.name: P:DotVVM.BusinessPack.Messaging.MessagingConnection.ReconnectTimeout
member.summary: Gets or sets the timeout in seconds for establishing the connection to the hub.

member.name: P:DotVVM.BusinessPack.Messaging.MessagingConnection.TryReconnect
member.summary: Gets or sets whether the control should try to reconnect when the connection is lost.

member.name: P:DotVVM.BusinessPack.Messaging.MessagingConnection.ConnectionId
member.summary: Gets or sets a unique ID of the connection. You can use this ID in _messaging.GetConnection() method in static commands, or to assign stand-alone MessageHandlers to this connection. Make sure that the connection ID is unique in the page. If the property value is not specified, the ID will be generated automatically.

member.name: P:DotVVM.BusinessPack.Messaging.MessagingConnection.IsConnected
member.summary: Gets or sets whether the hub is connected.

member.name: P:DotVVM.BusinessPack.Messaging.MessagingConnection.Connected
member.summary: Gets or sets a command that will be triggered when the connection is established.

member.name: P:DotVVM.BusinessPack.Messaging.MessagingConnection.Reconnecting
member.summary: Gets or sets a command that will be triggered when the hub connection is lost and will be retried.

member.name: P:DotVVM.BusinessPack.Messaging.MessagingConnection.Disconnected
member.summary: Gets or sets a command that will be triggered when the hub connection is lost and will not be retried (when TryReconnect is false or when the number of attempts reached the value of the ReconnectAttempts property).

member.name: P:DotVVM.BusinessPack.Messaging.MessagingConnection.Error
member.summary: Gets or sets a command that will be triggered when a communication error occurs.

member.name: P:DotVVM.BusinessPack.Messaging.MessagingConnection.MessageHandlers
member.summary: Gets or sets a collection of message handlers. Use this collection to specify handlers for various hub methods.
